content:
Sam W: Heads up — AcmeCorp POC is greenlit. They require SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning and RBAC mappings. Need to lock technical/price/security blockers before Wed. @Jordan can you confirm pricing stance?
Jordan (AE): They asked for group-to-role mapping, SCIM delta sync behavior, and domain-locked tenant. Preference is Hosted but want domain controls. I can give a POC discount for 30 days, need confirmation on post-POC pricing band.
Alisa (SE): For Hosted we support domain-locked tenants + standard SAML. SCIM supports group sync and role mapping; deltas are eventual-consistent (typical ~30-60s). 100 seats is trivial. Need to know authoritative source for role assignment (Okta groups vs in-app).
Prashant (Security): Legal/security questions: 1) Do we store SCIM tokens? 2) KMS for encryption? 3) Audit log retention length? Also they want an example SAML attribute for role claim (urn:acme:role).
Marie (PS): I'll draft the SSO onboarding doc. Can someone paste the minimal SAML metadata snippet and our RBAC names (Admin/Editor/Viewer)? Also acceptance criteria for the POC?
Jordan (AE): Customer intent: Okta -> group mapping. POC seat distribution: Admin 1, Editors 5, Viewers ~94. Pricing: 30-day free POC; post-POC hosted-credit rate, or upgrade to Dedicated (apply enterprise add-ons). I'll prepare formal quote.
Alisa (SE): Two technical notes: 1) Domain proofing: we require a DNS TXT record (no auto-claim for subdomains). 2) SCIM bulk for 10k users is out of scope for this POC but fine for 100 users. Also provisioning rate default is 20 req/s.
Sam W: Legal flagged audit retention — customer wants 365 days instead of our default 90. @Prashant can we offer 1yr for a POC?
Prashant (Security): We can extend audit retention to 365d as a one-off for Hosted Enterprise with an add-on; Dedicated includes configurable retention. We store SCIM tokens encrypted in customer KMS (or our KMS with envelope encryption). Will add SOC2 appendix note.
Jordan (AE): Customer SQ quick answers: Q: Signed SAML assertions? A: yes, we support signed/verified assertions + cert rotation. Q: SCIM token storage? A: encrypted at rest in KMS, minimal TTL. Q: RBAC mapping examples? A: we support group attribute -> urn:acme:role mapping.
Alisa (SE): Example SAML attribute mapping snippet to share with their Okta engineer:
```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="urn:acme:role">
    <AttributeValue>admin</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```
Marie (PS): POC runbook (draft): day 0: exchange metadata.xml + DNS TXT for domain proofing; day 1: SCIM initial sync; day 2: smoke tests (login + create/update user + role mapping); day 3: acceptance sign-off. Need acceptance criteria.
Sam W: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) Successful SSO login for 3 Admins, 2) SCIM create+update for 10 users, 3) Role mapping verified for Admin/Editor/Viewer, 4) Login latency <300ms for SSO flow, 5) Audit logs visible in console for operations in the POC window.
Jordan (AE): I'll schedule the handoff call Wed 10am with customer + Okta engineer and share the quote beforehand. @Marie please join for runbook + validation.
Marie (PS): On it. Also confirm SCIM provisioning rate (20 req/s) is acceptable for their initial sync — they said yes for 100 users.
Sam W: I uploaded the security questionnaire draft here (internal): https://redwood.co/sq/acme-poc — please add notes.
Jordan (AE): I'll attach the pricing draft after call. Thanks everyone — will update thread after Wed meeting. :thumbsup:
